_comment: Canonical handshake lines as each client emits them. The Rust suite (wire_fixture.rs) asserts the live parser accepts every one; the python line is the retired Linux client's, kept as a shape the parser still accepts. The Kotlin/Swift lines are copies of what Handshake.kt / Handshake.swift format, and editing one here without the app's own suite green is the drift this file exists to catch.
